description: Matrix shapes uses Unicode nullable packed and dictionary keys; one/two ordering terms, widths 32/256, k 3/100, one/four selections sharing preparation with all results retained. Two warmups/six samples, alternating variant order. Cache construction included, fixture construction and independent stable-sort oracle excluded. 64 MiB modeled pool; dictionaries decode unique values only. Matrix cardinality varies dictionary size 64/1024/10000 and selection stride 1/10/100 at one selection per preparation, nulls last, with exact-direct-cap pressure trials.
limitations: Sequential synchronous Node selections with retained outputs model reuse/overlap, not asynchronous cloud jobs.
Unicode allocation uses a conservative UTF16 upper bound derived from UTF8 bytes; runtime/native/GC overhead and oracle memory are outside reservation accounting.
Experimental cache only; no production policy or timing threshold inferred from one run.
